name: simple_created_by
query:
find Artist, Work
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)

name: join_exhibited
query:
find Artist, Work, Gallery
where
  person(Artist)
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  exhibited_at(Work, Gallery)

name: range_year_ge_1970
query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y >= 1970

name: range_year_between
query:
find Artist, Work, Y
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  year_created(Work, Y)
  Y between 1975 and 1980

name: range_integer
query:
find Work, M
where
  duration_minutes(Work, M)
  M > 10

name: optional_order
query:
find Artist, Work
where
  person(Artist)
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  optional
    created_by(Work, Artist)
order by Artist ascending

name: negation
query:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  not
    funded_by(Artist, arts_council)

name: invalid_unsafe_negation
query:
find Artist
where
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  not
    funded_by(Artist, F)

name: invalid_type_mismatch
query:
find W
where
  year_created(W, Y)
  Y >= @1970-01-01
